name: inventory

scripts.start:py-user: cd projects/user-service/backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.start:py-inventory: cd projects/inventory-hub/backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.start:py-store: cd projects/store-service/backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.start:py-gateway: cd projects/api-gateway && uv run python run.py
scripts.start:all-micro: pnpm run build:lib && concurrently -k -n "Shell,User-FE,Store-FE,Inv-FE,User-API,Inv-API,Store-API,Gateway" -c "magenta,blue,blue,blue,cyan,green,yellow,gray" "pnpm start:shell" "pnpm start:user" "pnpm start:store" "pnpm start:inventory" "pnpm start:py-user" "pnpm start:py-inventory" "pnpm start:py-store" "pnpm start:py-gateway"
scripts.start:frontend-mock: pnpm run build:lib && concurrently -k -n "Shell,User-FE,Store-FE,Inv-FE,Mock-DB" -c "magenta,blue,blue,blue,gray" "pnpm start:shell" "pnpm start:user" "pnpm start:store" "pnpm start:inventory" "pnpm start:backend"
